name: Kindan no Sekai e Shin Sekai e no Sasoi
original_name: 禁断の世界へ 新世界への誘い
source:
An honors student girl became interest in sex.
She went online and saw photos of naked people.
So she got naked and wandered around school.

She also walked home this way, attracting some men...

translation:
一名优等生开始对性产生兴趣。
她上网看到了裸体照片，
于是也脱光衣服，在校园里四处游荡。

她甚至就这样步行回家，引来了几个男人……
